title_en: You can complain about sexual harassment at work
law: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, Sections 2, 4, 6 and 9
rule_plain: Sexual harassment at work includes unwanted touching, asking for sexual favours, sexual remarks, showing pornography, and other unwanted sexual behaviour. Every office must have an Internal Committee. A woman can complain in writing within three months of the incident.
what_you_can_do: Complain in writing to the Internal Committee at your workplace.
If your workplace has fewer than ten workers, or the complaint is against the employer, complain to the Local Committee set up by the District Collector.
If you cannot write, a committee member must help you write the complaint.
The committee can give you three more months to complain if there was a good reason for the delay.
where_to_get_help: Internal Committee at your workplace, or the Local Committee of your district. In Tamil Nadu, the District Social Welfare Officer is the nodal officer.
